content: In the case of the Experts, the grammatical verb-nominal version (V-N) had better F-score performance. The verbal version (V) obtained a better accuracy $P$ than the verb-nominal (V-N). In the case of the Naive, the performance F-score, $P$ and $R$ is very similar from the Experts.
